title: From Rule-based to Agentic: LLM Agent based Real-time Control of Urban Drainage Systems for Flooding and Sewer Overflow Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-time control (RTC) for urban drainage systems (UDS) remains hampered by sparse in-network sensing. While heterogeneous multi-modal meteorological early warnings often contain decision-critical information for UDS RTC, none of the existing approaches can exploit such externally-sourced information within the control workflow. Here we introduce AgenticAI-Control, an agentic artificial intelligence framework able to assimilate multi-source meteorological early warnings in RTC. Two coupled large language model agents are integrated to generate control strategies by retrieving meteorological early-warnings and fusing them with domain engineering expertise. Validated via simulation studies of a combined sewer catchment in eastern China across 10 real-world rainfall events, the AgenticAI-Control achieved 69.1-90.6% reduction in aggregated flood and overflow volumes compared to the rule-based baseline control. Rigorously standardized prompt

translated_title: 从基于规则到智能体化：基于大语言模型智能体的城市排水系统实时控制以缓解洪涝与污水溢流
translated_abstract: 城市排水系统（UDS）的实时控制（RTC）仍受限于管网内稀疏的传感监测。尽管异构多模态的气象预警信息往往包含对城市排水系统实时控制至关重要的决策信息，但现有方法均无法在控制工作流中利用这类外部来源的信息。本文提出AgenticAI-Control，一个能够在实时控制中融合多源气象预警信息的智能体人工智能框架。该框架集成了两个耦合的大语言模型智能体，通过检索气象预警信息并将其与领域工程专业知识相融合来生成控制策略。通过对中国东部某合流制排水流域在10场真实降雨事件下的仿真研究进行验证，与基于规则的基线控制相比，AgenticAI-Control使洪涝与溢流总量减少了69.1%至90.6%。经过严格标准化的提示词……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出AgenticAI-Control智能体框架，利用两个耦合的大语言模型智能体将多源气象预警信息与工程专业知识融合，实现城市排水系统的实时控制，相比规则基线控制使洪涝与溢流总量减少69.1%-90.6%。
en_tdlr: The study introduces AgenticAI-Control, an agentic AI framework using two coupled LLM agents to assimilate multi-source meteorological early warnings with engineering expertise for real-time control of urban drainage systems, reducing flood and overflow volumes by 69.1-90.6% compared to rule-based baseline control.
